bio.text: Janelle Stelson is the Democratic nominee for Pennsylvania's 10th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election, having advanced from the May 19, 2026 primary.
She also ran for the seat in 2024, when Republican incumbent Scott Perry defeated her.
According to Ballotpedia, she is a former news anchor, reporter and weather anchor at WGAL-TV, and her first job was writing speeches for the Egyptian embassy in Washington, D.C.
Ballotpedia also reports that she was born in Fairbanks, Alaska, grew up in the Seattle area, and received a bachelor's degree in politics and government from the University of Puget Sound.
